sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Engineering leader and software architect with deep expertise in building scalable, high-availability applications. Committed to clean code, thoughtful system design, and delivering measurable business outcomes. Seeking a technology leadership role to drive product impact, elevate engineering practices, and mentor high-performing teams.

highlights.text: Led team-wide adoption of AI development tools, increasing automated test coverage and accelerating delivery timelines.
Leveraged AWS Kiro (AI IDE) for spec-driven development, reducing a month-long effort to just 2 days.
Instituted TDD practices for all new projects, resulting in cleaner codebases and consistently above 80% line coverage.
Rearchitected the project structure to improve codebase navigability, enabling front-end engineers to contribute effectively to the API layer.
Built a wealth management platform from the ground up, managing AUM exceeding ₹14,000 crores and executing a seamless data migration for clients, RMs, and the operations team.
Collaborated cross-functionally to map existing workflows and implement technology solutions that significantly reduced manual effort for the operations team.
Integrated multiple fintech vendor APIs to enhance and automate core business processes.
Developed an OKR platform with integrations for Google Sheets, Zoho, and other tools to automate objective and key result tracking.
Engineered a high-throughput notification system capable of dispatching hundreds of thousands of messages while respecting Facebook Workplace's rate limits.
Built custom Workplace by Facebook bot integrations to streamline internal workflows.
Developed a chatbot integration for the Kwench rewards and recognition platform.
Built and maintained the iOS application from scratch.
